name: bitgalaxy-shell
description: BitGalaxy Shell：单进程桌面应用（Tauri 2）：内嵌 Agent（SSH 数据面 + WS 工作台 + 桌宠 + MCP stdio）

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:ui && npm run build:pet
scripts.desktop:assets: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:ui && npm run build:pet && node scripts/prep-assets.mjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:assets && start "bgshell-dev-ui" /min npm run dev:ui && start "bgshell-dev-pet" /min npm run dev:pet && npm run dev -w @bgshell/desktop
scripts.desktop:exe: npm run desktop:assets && npm run build:exe-only -w @bgshell/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:assets && npm run build -w @bgshell/desktop
